svg.title: Boundary port with up arrow
svg.desc: Rounded boundary glyph containing the up direction indication. Glyph component only. Center it on a matching host boundary and supply the side-specific label. Arrow choice is caller-supplied; no feature-direction inference, nested-port layout, broken reference outline or proxy option.
